title: DHS Dindigul Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for 36 ANM, Medical Officer and Other Posts
description: District Health Society Dindigul (DHS Dindigul) has issued the official notification for 2026. To fill the vacancies for 36 Mid-Level Health Providers, ANM, District Quality Consultant, Medical Officer, and Other Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in any degree, ANM, B.Sc, B.Sc Nursing, BDS, BUMS, Diploma, GNM, 12th, MBBS, MD/ MS, or Post Graduation can grab this chance and apply for the DHS Dindigul Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure...
